correctness.rationale: For every nonzero error the conditional ratio is the probability-weighted sum of the squared coordinate factors. The binomial marginals give 1 - k(2β−β²)S₂ + k(k−1)β²S₃; every simplex point is admissible. An independent sharp certificate beyond the source's pair-splitting argument is S₃ ≤ (1+1/d)S₂−1/d. With E_j the elementary symmetric sums of p, the gap times d is (d−2)E₂−3dE₃, exactly Σ_l p_l Σ_{i<j, i,j≠l}(p_i−p_j)². The cubic coefficient is nonnegative, so the resulting chord bounds the objective by the larger endpoint, and both endpoints attain it. At d=2 the chord is an identity and at the positive crossing all splits tie; β=0 also gives ties. The theorem asserts witnesses, not exclusivity. The uniform-minus-vertex gap changes sign once at β_c=2d/[k(d+1)−1] for β>0. The vertex minimum 1/k lies strictly before that crossing, and the uniform minimum d/(d+k−1) lies at or before it exactly when k(d−1)≤2d−1. The envelope thus has the stated unique optimum, including equality of branches. The vertex requires 0<β<2/k and the uniform branch stays below one throughout that window (its own positive crossing is 2d/(d+k−1)≥2/k). This covers k=1 and the absorbing zero-error case in the conditional iteration. The fixed-d floor follows from the balanced branch; under fixed-uniform sampling every coordinate has the same expected multiplier and the uniform quadratic is exact for every start. I inspected verify.py and its documented finite replay without executing it; the count and Monte Carlo figures are frozen supporting evidence, not the basis of the universal check.
residual_risks: No wall-clock, nonorthogonal, live-read, or exact long-run-rate result is established.

value.rationale: The condition-one benchmark isolates occupancy collisions from matrix conditioning. It answers a motivated robust tuning question: which of uniform fractional coverage and duplicate hits on a single residual dominates at the best step? The all-dimension sharp crossover and persistent quantitative gap versus fixed-uniform sampling supply that design information; the floor is not a limitation on repeatedly refreshed accuracy.
residual_risks: Does not estimate actual machine throughput or extrapolate to correlated rows.
